warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vito 110/111 CDI Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: If your Vito 110/111 CDI is a W639 generation model with the OM646 engine - that's roughly 2006 to 2014 - timing chain wear and injector seal leaks are well-documented patterns on this engine. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM646 rebuild.
The earlier W638 generation uses the OM601 or OM611 engine families, which don't share this specific issue pattern - they're older, different designs with their own service requirements.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-vito.md. OM601 and OM611 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
